steps.why: Knowlu answers one question every morning: what's next? Next, you'll connect the places that already know your work, about 10 minutes.

steps.why: One school sign-in lets Knowlu read your classes, class times, assignments, grades and school email. You won't sign in to these again.

steps.title: Payment
steps.why: Everything you just connected keeps running every day for $9.99 a month, after 7 days free.
steps.ask: Checkout in your browser (Stripe). Other options: $39.99 for a 6-month term; Pell Grant recipients pay 75% less.
steps.proof: Your trial is on. First charge October 25.
steps.tester_variant: Nothing to pay: you're a tester.

steps.title: School email
steps.why: Professors change dates by email. Knowlu reads what arrives and proposes each change for you to approve.
steps.ask: Nothing new: your school sign-in covers it
steps.proof: Forwarding on. Test message arrived in 38 s. New mail is read as it arrives; older school mail is still coming in.
steps.skip_cost: Date changes and new work announced by email are missed.

steps.title: Your Google account: Gmail and Calendar
steps.why: Clubs, jobs and internships write to your Gmail, and your calendar says when you're already busy. One Google permission covers both, read-only.
steps.ask: One Google consent for Gmail and Calendar together (read-only). While Knowlu is unverified, Google shows a warning screen first: choose Advanced, then continue.
steps.gmail_history_note: Gmail by permission brings in the last 7 days of mail.
steps.proof: Read 40 recent messages; 1 thing to do (Pre-Health dues, added). 6 events this week, 3 repeating ones to check on Your week.
steps.fallback: If you decline or the read fails: set up Gmail forwarding instead (2-4 min).
steps.skip_cost: Club, job and internship tasks from Gmail are missed; free time ignores your own events.

steps.title: Another calendar
steps.why: If your calendar isn't Google's, add it so your free time is honest.
steps.note: Not shown for Maya: step 6 granted Google Calendar.
